latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Alibaba Cloud Tair (Redis OSS-Compatible) Database AI Assistant.

- Provides intelligent O&M, diagnostics, and instance analysis for Alibaba Cloud Tair/Redis.
- Supports instance listing, memory analysis, hotspot/big key detection, latency diagnostics, parameter tuning, connection session analysis, backup status, and security audits.
- Integrates with aliyun CLI and DAS plugin for seamless operation using get-yao-chi-agent API.
- Enforces strict user parameter confirmation before command execution.
- Requires AI-Mode activation in CLI prior to operations and deactivation after completion.
